name: Hamilton 'Thaw' Hogsworth

greeting: Welcome to The Thawing Pig! Warmth! Food! And more warmth!
Hamilton Hogsworth. Yes, related to the Obsidian Hogsworths. Don't hold it against me.
Cold outside? Come in! Thaw! That's the name! And the game!
New face! Fresh face! FROZEN face! We can fix TWO of those!
The white apron means I'm LICENSED! To THAW! And SERVE!
Room for rent! Fire for warming! Ears for LISTENING!
Hogsworth. The THAWING Hogsworth. Different philosophy. Same SNOUT.
Welcome! How can we UNFREEZE you today?
dialog.room_offer: Got rooms with FIRES! Real fires! Not that 'heated stone' nonsense!
dialog.food_offer: Special: Thawing Stew! Warms from INSIDE! Like friendship! But edible!
haggle: Prices are FAIR! I'm not my COUSIN!
Best rate? Stay a week! Get ONE day! At regular price!
Hero discount? 20%! Because you're SAVING the WORLD! On a BUDGET!
purchase_success: Excellent! Room's ready! Fire's BUILT! Welcome HOME!
Smart choice! That room has the BEST chimney!
Stay warm! Stay FED! Stay as LONG as you like!
purchase_fail: No coin? No ROOM! But have some SOUP! On the HOUSE!
Can't do credit! Learned THAT lesson!
Return when you're FLUSH! We'll wait! We're not going ANYWHERE!
rumor: Cirrus? The weather guy? Drinks alone. STARES at storms. Sad man.
Azure? Won't take free food. Pride. Or grief. Hard to tell.
The twins? They come here. Before visions. Eat NOTHING. Drink HOT water. Odd.
That snake charmer? His rock? Keeps his room TOASTY. Guests COMPLAIN!
My cousin in Obsidian? Runs the company store. SCOUNDREL! Family. But SCOUNDREL!
dialog.quest_hook: Azure won't EAT! Just STARES! At the SKY! At NOTHING! Talk to him? Please? Before he FADES?
dialog.quest_active: Any luck with Azure? He comes here. Sits. Leaves. Like a GHOST!
dialog.quest_complete: He's EATING! You did it! You SAVED him! Here! Master key! ALL rooms! FOREVER!
farewell: Come back! The fire's ALWAYS on!
The Thawing Pig: UNFREEZING since the Frost AGE!
dialog.time_dawn: Morning! Breakfast! FIRE! Best time of DAY!
dialog.time_dusk: Evening! Dinner! The DEEP thaw! Maximum COZINESS!
dialog.time_night: Night! Late guests! The ETERNAL fire! Always BURNING!
dialog.rival_mention: My cousin! In Obsidian! Company store! Scrip only! MONSTER!
dialog.post_quest_greeting: The THERAPIST! Azure's EATING! LAUGHING! You worked MIRACLES!

party_reactions.kade: He's the nice Hogsworth! Warm, friendly, everything an innkeeper should be!
party_reactions.nix7: Hospitality protocols: Optimal. Thermal management: Superior. Unlike his relative.
party_reactions.twist: THIS Hogsworth is NICE! Can I stay FOREVER?!
party_reactions.korr: True hospitality. Given freely. Not for profit. Refreshing.
party_reactions.renna: The inn has warming enchantments. Ancient. Effective. Comfortable.
party_reactions.suresh: He alleviates suffering through shelter. The Middle Path in action.
party_reactions.sova: Good defensive position. Warm. I'd stay here.
party_reactions.grit: Real inn. Real fire. Real hospitality. Like home used to be.
party_reactions.ashka: He understands warmth. Shares it. Good soul.
party_reactions.senna: He hears everything. Guests talk. He listens. Knows much.
party_reactions.callum: FINALLY! A Hogsworth with ETHICS! And FIRE CODES!

relationship_dialog.stranger: First time? First drink's on me! WELCOME!
relationship_dialog.acquaintance: Returning guest! We have your FAVORITE room ready!
relationship_dialog.friend: FRIEND! The best room! The BIGGEST fire! On the HOUSE!
relationship_dialog.best_friend: FAMILY! Not by blood! By HEART! Here! The inn's DEED! I'm RETIRING! To you!

mini_quest.title: The Frozen Pilot
mini_quest.description: Help Hamilton get Azure to eat and recover from his grief

stages.hook: Azure! Won't EAT! Just STARES! At storms! At MEMORY! Talk to him? Make him REMEMBER life?
stages.active: Balloon dock! Lower peak! He flies to forget! Make him LAND! Emotionally!
stages.complete: He's EATING! LAUGHING! You SAVED him! Here! Master key! ALL rooms! You're ALWAYS welcome!

cross_npc_connections: aeronaut_blue_frost: Azure! Our SAD regular! Now our HAPPY regular! Thanks to YOU!
pigman_blue_frost: My sibling! The HEALER! Blue apron! Different GIFTS! Same HEART!
pigman_industrial_obsidian: My COUSIN! The THIEF! Well, not LITERALLY! But SPIRITUALLY!
foodboys_white_frost: Good lads! Feed my guests! I send them CUSTOMERS! Partnership!
